knowledge_policy.dated_time: Use the explicit exchange/official publication timestamp and timezone, never retrieval time as a historical known time.
knowledge_policy.date_only: Use next calendar day00:00 America/New_York as a conservative date-upper-bound research convention only when the official US-market dateline is unambiguous. Preserve the date-only precision/zone assumption; not an assertion of actual first dissemination.
knowledge_policy.missing_or_ambiguous_date: knowledge_at=null andunknown; no guessed earliest date from URL/year/search snippet.
knowledge_policy.filing_vs_publication: Effective/filing/publication times are distinct. A retrospectively effective rule is not known on its effective date unless public evidence existed then.
knowledge_policy.vintage: A currently downloaded page with an old dateline is not by itself a verified first vintage. Record immutable dated official PDF vs mutable dated release vs current-only text separately. Revisions without version timing are unknown for affected claims.
knowledge_policy.precedence: Only applicable already-known later explicit notices can supersede a baseline rule. Keep append-only versions; never overwrite earlier expected schedules with final realized closures.
knowledge_policy.last_day: For future candidate use, a known planned trading date d is expected-last only if the then-known schedule excludes every remaining date in that month and includes the next planned open afterward. Later surprise closes never retroactively relabel d.
knowledge_policy.first_three: For future candidate use, count only already-confirmed opened sessions since the civil month start, including current d only if confirmation is available by the chosen clock. Planned-open at09:29 and confirmed-open by09:46 are distinct states.
knowledge_policy.tri_state_OR: For future fixedproxy: any known true branch=>true; both knownfalse=>false; otherwiseunknown. Unknown is never filled0. Source intake stores knowledge eligibility only and does not compute this feature.
knowledge_policy.unexpected_closure_audit: Compare known-schedule expectations with the final observed calendar solely as a source discrepancy ledger; discrepancies cannot select windows, alter timestamps or produce historical signal corrections.
